term: common local grounding source and rigid tagged candidates
definition: The existing LocalState s supplies source existence, concreteness and grounds. Individuals in both profiles are ordinary rigid pairs (Bool tag, source coordinate). The old doubled profile has tag equal to the world; rigid copies exactly its world-false existence, Causes and grounds assignments to every world, retaining the same concrete predicate and universal frame. The source coordinate is a role in the common local structure, not by itself the identity of the tagged individual. LocalLaws repeats exactly the old preserved source constraints, with an independently supplied noninitial predicate.
note: Analyst comparison for #1078; no physical/metaphysical possibility or real identity criterion established. Grounding and Causes reuse the old supplied relation without independently identifying them. See docs/notes/grounding-identity-profile.md.
